planned_change: Count a separator group as a quark of its sequence short name. Reuse the one quark only when it is not the group the lookup runs in, and that lookup is the owner when the current group is already a concurrent region. A declaration of the current group's short name creates a child. A link with several quarks of that name resolves in the current scope, which at the root is a new state. A link whose ends have different concurrent ancestors is the final-error case and is reported as line 1, Syntax Error?.
